NOTE: BBC (21 Jul) "Andy Burnham's first 24 hours" — Healey's appointment a surprise. Burnham ally Anneliese Midgeley tasked with keeping Labour MPs (incl sacked ministers) loyal. Darren Jones's public swipe at energy-bills policy "a sign not all will play nice." One Labour MP: those sacked split into three groups — "Some went because of their politics, others just weren't good, and then there are those disliked in the parliamentary Labour party."
